items.title: fix(tui): scope MCP startup status by thread
fix(tui): scope MCP startup status by thread
fix(tui): deliver MCP startup updates to side threads
fix(app-server): allow app-scoped MCP startup events

observed_change: Codex adds nullable `threadId` ownership to app-server MCP startup notifications and routes TUI MCP startup diagnostics to the owning thread.
changed_surfaces: app-server protocol schema and generated TypeScript
TUI side-thread event buffering and MCP startup replay
user_visible_path: When a spawned subagent has MCP startup failures, the parent TUI transcript should no longer receive repeated yellow warnings; the child thread keeps the detailed failure and final incomplete-startup summary, and stale startup spinners should settle after thread refresh.
control_plane_relevance: Decodex app-server clients and protocol adapters should accept and preserve `mcpServer/startupStatus/updated.threadId`, including `null` for app-scoped startup, when routing MCP lifecycle status.
compatibility_risk: High for exhaustive or generated app-server clients that assumed `{ name, status, error }` was the full MCP startup notification payload or that route every missing-thread notification into the active transcript.
adoption_opportunity: Update Decodex Control Plane app-server handling to use thread-scoped MCP startup status as an ownership signal and to treat null `threadId` as app-scoped rather than current-thread scoped.
community_value: High for app-server and multi-agent users because the fix reduces noisy parent-thread warnings and documents a protocol field external clients need to handle.
deprecated_or_breaking_notes: The notification shape changes from `{ name, status, error }` to `{ threadId, name, status, error }`; tests preserve deserialization of missing `threadId` as `None`, but clients with strict schemas may need updates.
evidence: PR #26639 says subagent MCP startup failures were rendered as global notifications and could pollute the parent transcript.
The generated JSON schemas and TypeScript type add nullable `threadId` to `mcpServer/startupStatus/updated` notifications.
codex-rs/app-server/README.md documents `{ threadId, name, status, error }` and says `threadId` is null when startup is app-scoped.
codex-rs/app-server/src/bespoke_event_handling.rs populates `thread_id` from the current app-server conversation id for thread-scoped lifecycle updates.
codex-rs/tui/src/app/app_server_event_targets.rs routes MCP startup notifications by thread and returns `AppScoped` when `threadId` is absent.
codex-rs/tui/src/chatwidget/mcp_startup.rs suppresses identical repeated failure warnings for the same server in one startup round.
The normalized bundle artifacts/github/bundles/openai-codex-pr-26639.json records 18 changed files for the merged PR.
caveats: The PR documents current thread-scoped lifecycle and future app-scoped support; app-scoped null notifications are ignored by the TUI until there is an app-level target.

next_actions.reason: This is an app-server protocol and Control Plane routing compatibility change.
The protocol and multi-agent behavior change has a clear operator-facing public angle.
